test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.

Online summer camps in different sports have been arranged for students by the education ministry.

options.text: By the education ministry in different sports online summer camps have been arranged for students.
The education ministry is arranging online summer camps in different sports for students.
The education ministry has arranged online summer camps in different sports for students.
Online summer camps in different sports are going to be arranged by the education ministry for students

solution:
The correct answer is **"The education ministry has arranged online summer camps in different sports for students.".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The construction of Active Voice here is –

 **Subject + has / have + Verb****3 ****Object**

 The construction of Passive Voice here is –

 **Subject1 + has / have + been + Verb3 + (by + agent)**
 
• Look at an example:
 
 
• Active: Seema **has bought** a car.

 Passive: A car **has been bought** by Seema.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *The education ministry has arranged online summer camps in different sports for students.*
